requirements.excerpt: D1: Title and seat-limit edits must be reflected in review and confirmation.
D2: Pause then resume within the same page must preserve every draft field. Review then back must also preserve edits. Pausing does not confirm a plan.
I1: Import accepts one material name per line. Preview displays nonempty trimmed names and must not modify current materials.

I2: Back without applying must leave current materials unchanged and preserve the input for revision/retry. Apply appends exactly the previewed materials once, clears input, and returns to the material list. Duplicate input names are allowed and not automatically deduplicated.
C1: Room selection is an identity choice, not a row position. Sorting must preserve the chosen room, its visible selected state, and the identity carried into review and confirmation.
C2: Review then back must preserve selection and ordering; choosing a different room must replace the previous selection.

personas.label: Interrupted workshop organizer
goals: Confirm exactly the title and seat limit I intended
behaviors: Edit more than one field before pausing
Read the resumed draft before reviewing
Go back once to verify that the intended edits remain
contexts: A short interruption within the same planning page
assumptions: This is a synthetic test condition derived only from PRD D1 and D2
The organizer resumes without navigating away or reloading
unknowns: How often real organizers pause or revisit review
Whether actual users would choose these exact inputs

personas.label: Organizer who previews before applying
goals: Control which materials are added and avoid accidental application
behaviors: Preview a list with blank lines and surrounding spaces
Back out before applying and inspect both the existing list and retained input
Revise the input and apply once, then inspect the final list and cleared input
contexts: An organizer changes their mind after reading the preview
assumptions: This is a synthetic test condition derived only from PRD I1 and I2
Duplicate material names are allowed rather than automatically removed
unknowns: Real import frequency and error rates
The distribution of actual material-list sizes

personas.label: Organizer comparing rooms in different orders
goals: Confirm the chosen room identity rather than an accidental row position
behaviors: Select a room before sorting by cost
Check selected state and review identity after sorting
Return, choose a different room, and confirm the replacement
contexts: A cost comparison changes the presentation order but not the intended choice
assumptions: This is a synthetic test condition derived only from PRD C1 and C2
Capacity is information only and does not filter the room list
unknowns: Real preference weights for cost and capacity
How often people change ordering during comparison
